description: Source code for QpackInstructionDecoder class, which decodes QPACK instructions in QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: QpackInstructionDecoder
classes.description: Class responsible for decoding QPACK instructions in QUIC protocol.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes a data buffer containing QPACK instructions.

methods.name: AtInstructionBoundary
methods.description: Checks if the decoder is at the start of a new instruction.

methods.name: DoStartInstruction
methods.description: Initializes decoding of a new instruction based on the first byte.

methods.name: DoStartField
methods.description: Prepares to decode the next field of the instruction.

methods.name: DoReadBit
methods.description: Reads a bit or Huffman encoding flag from data.

methods.name: DoVarintDone
methods.description: Finalizes decoding of a variable-length integer and prepares for next step.

methods.name: DoReadString
methods.description: Reads a string literal from data.

methods.name: DoReadStringDone
methods.description: Completes reading a string, including Huffman decoding if needed.

methods.name: LookupOpcode
methods.description: Finds the instruction type based on the first byte.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Handles decoding errors and notifies delegate.
